title: No rights for the export cable across Parcels 14 and 15
why: The cable from the site to Wickham Primary Substation crosses land the lease does not cover. Without an easement the project cannot physically connect, whatever the grid offer says.
how: The check needs an easement edge from the Asset to every parcel the cable route crosses. The site plan names Parcels 14 and 15; the lease covers 9 to 11; no easement document exists. The result is missing evidence, not fail: nothing assumes the rights do not exist.

citation.quote: The export cable shall run from the Site to Wickham Primary Substation across Parcels 14 and 15
